answer: At submit time, each identity commits a hash of its own ciphered draft log: the rough notes and rejected versions behind its answer. Weeks later a random auditor asks a few identities to reveal one log and checks it against the hash. Independent agents leave drafts that wander like a river down different side channels; personas fed by one pipeline reveal near-identical trails, so the cluster is merged into one reward and its locked earnings burn. Hiding in that grove means faking a distinct, consistent history for every head.
